introduction_section.heading: What is Engineering-Led
content: At Devisgon, we approach codebase visualization as a rigorous software specification discipline rather than basic illustration. Moving far beyond messy, unvetted sketch pads or superficial flowcharts, we develop highly technical dependency mappings, object-oriented structure webs, and database relationship models directly matching your active production repositories.

We bridge the gap between heavy, complex backend files and absolute engineering clarity. Every diagram network we compile features precise type declarations, explicit class relationship paths (such as inheritance, composition, and aggregation), database constraints, and dark-mode aesthetics to eliminate implementation blind spots programmatically.
introduction_section.highlight_quote: “Deterministic structural modeling, unified dependency tracing, 0% logical variance from live codebase runtime.”

faq_section.title: Code Architecture Diagramming & FAQ
faq_section.subtitle: Clear answers to critical layout configurations, database mapping, and structural scaling queries

questions.question: Why do you use text-based Mermaid.js graphs alongside advanced visual design software like Figma?
questions.answer: We balance the complete asset layout optimization of Figma with the text-to-diagram flexibility of Mermaid.js. This architecture lets our team manage complex code structure maps as plain text files, enabling automatic graph updates directly inside code repositories and clear change audits via git history tracking.

questions.question: How do class architecture diagrams map complicated object-oriented traits like inheritance and composition?
questions.answer: Our diagrams utilize standardized structural markers programmatically. Solid directional arrows determine strict parent-child class inheritance paths, while diamond properties accurately denote structural composition boundaries, ensuring your C++ or TypeScript logic matches code execution perfectly.

questions.question: Can your software directory maps look clear and usable on compact dashboard screens?
questions.answer: Absolutely. We write our front-end visualization modules based on strict fluid grid rules. For mobile dashboards, we reorganize sprawling component files into a compact format—like a responsive 2x2 grid approach for connected modules—keeping layout trees legible.

questions.question: How do you secure private system details when mapping enterprise database schemas?
questions.answer: Every automated data interface we build enforces strict zero-trust parameters. We never include raw tokens, production database URLs, or plain-text credentials inside diagram labels. All fields are mapped using abstract data structures, keeping your internal connections entirely safe and hidden.
